text:
Rina: Quick note from ClearQuay onboarding / renewal in ~6w: two asks — (1) a single downloadable export that shows route -> token counts -> dollar cost, FP&A needs it; (2) a way to mute non-actionable alerts during business hours.
Omar: Can we get the exact CSV layout from them? Need to drop into productboard.
Rina: They sent a sample layout during the call. Quote: 'We need a one-click export for finance; manual dashboards won't cut it.'
Diego: Dev quick take: if per-route aggregations already exist, making a CSV endpoint + small UI download is ~2w. Adding accurate $ cost requires pricing join and QA ~3-4w.
Hannah: Snooze/mute alert feature (org quiet hours) should be low effort, ~1w, and reduces noise immediately.
Rina: They explicitly asked for cost columns but said they'd accept interim counts CSV if we give them beta access to the full cost export. They offered to test.
Omar: Action items: 1) Diego confirm aggregation dependency & ETA in 48h; 2) Rina upload sample CSV and confirm beta; 3) Hannah create productboard item and mark renewal-risk. Check back in 72h.
product-bot: Created PB-7120 "ClearQuay export + alert-snooze" tags=[cs, renewal-risk].
Diego: I'll spike tomorrow and post blockers. If aggregations missing, interim is still possible via nightly job but ops cost to own.
Hannah: I'll add renewal flag in PB and notify AM. Keep this high touch.
Rina: Uploaded sample CSV to shared drive (link). They'll beta. Will DM any updates.
